description: This file defines the PdfTrueTypeFont class, which represents an OpenType font embedded in a PDF document within the PDFsharp library. It includes constructors for initializing the font from a PdfDocument with either an XFont or an XGlyphTypeface, manages font descriptors, encodings, and font metrics, and provides properties for setting font-related attributes in the PDF structure.

classes.name: PdfTrueTypeFont
classes.description: Represents a TrueType font embedded in a PDF document, providing font initialization, descriptor handling, and font attribute configuration.

classes.name: PdfTrueTypeFont.Keys
classes.description: Contains metadata keys for the PdfTrueTypeFont class, including font type, subtype, base font name, character code range, widths, font descriptor, encoding, and ToUnicode stream.

methods.name: PdfTrueTypeFont(PdfDocument)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new PdfTrueTypeFont instance with a PDF document.

methods.name: PdfTrueTypeFont(PdfDocument, XFont)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new PdfTrueTypeFont from an XFont and sets up font descriptor and encoding.

methods.name: PdfTrueTypeFont(PdfDocument, XGlyphTypeface)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new PdfTrueTypeFont from an XGlyphTypeface and sets up font descriptor and encoding.

methods.name: PrepareForSave
methods.description: Prepares the font object for saving into the PDF by setting character code ranges and widths.
